limitations: Thin-plate Kirchhoff limit only (a/h = 100); Mindlin/MITC4 thick-plate terms are graded by the separate thick-plate anchors.

Hard simple support (w = 0, tangential slope = 0) is used, which is the classical Navier/Timoshenko boundary condition; soft simple support is a different (and softer) problem and is not what 0.00406 refers to.
